The people who said no, among the People of the Book and those who worshipped idols, would not leave their way until a clear proof came to them.
The proof was a messenger from Allah, reading clean pages.
In those pages are right and true writings.
And the People of the Book only began to split apart after the clear proof came to them.
They were only told to worship Allah, with an honest heart, to be upright, to pray and to give. That is the right religion.
The people who said no, among the People of the Book and those who worshipped idols, will be in the fire of Hell, staying there. They are the worst of all creatures.
People who believe and do good are the best of all creatures.

Their reward with their Lord is gardens that last, with rivers flowing under them. They stay there forever. Allah is pleased with them and they are pleased with Him. That is for the one who fears his Lord.
